description: Shabbir Tiles & Ceramics Limited (STCL) is a tile manufacturer incorporated in Pakistan on 7 November 1978 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Founded in 1978 by the House of Habib, it describes itself as the country's first private-sector ceramic enterprise and sells under the brand STILE. It manufactures porcelain, vitrified and ceramic wall and floor tiles at three plants in Karachi and also trades allied building materials.
headOffice: 15th Milestone, National Highway, Landhi, Karachi, Pakistan
